import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:artificer_core/artificer_core.dart';
import 'package:artificer_core/protocols.dart';
import 'package:artificer_core/transport.dart';
import 'package:conflux/effect.dart';
import 'package:conflux/flow.dart';
import 'package:conflux/result.dart';

Future<void> verifyCompatibleProtocols() async {
  final server = await HttpServer.bind(InternetAddress.loopbackIPv4, 0);
  final records = <({String path, Map<String, Object?> body, String? auth})>[];
  final client = ProviderHttpClient();
  final runtime = Runtime();
  final base = Uri.parse('http://127.0.0.1:${server.port}');
  Map<String, Object?> responseBody() => {
    'id': 'response',
    'model': 'actual-model',
    'status': 'completed',
    'output': [
      {
        'type': 'message',
        'id': 'message',
        'role': 'assistant',
        'phase': 'final_answer',
        'content': [
          {'type': 'output_text', 'text': 'hello', 'annotations': []},
        ],
      },
    ],
    'usage': {'input_tokens': 2, 'output_tokens': 1, 'total_tokens': 3},
    'future': {
      'nested': [null, true],
    },
  };
  server.listen((request) async {
    final body = jsonDecode(await utf8.decoder.bind(request).join()) as Map<String, Object?>;
    records.add((path: request.uri.path, body: body, auth: request.headers.value('authorization')));
    request.response.headers.set('x-request-id', 'native-id');
    if (request.uri.path.startsWith('/chat')) {
      if (body['stream'] == true) {
        request.response.headers.contentType = ContentType('text', 'event-stream');
        request.response.write(
          'data: ${jsonEncode({
            'id': 'chat',
            'model': 'actual-model',
            'choices': [
              {
                'index': 0,
                'delta': {'role': 'assistant', 'content': 'hello'},
                'finish_reason': null,
              },
            ],
          })}\n\n',
        );
        request.response.write(
          'data: ${jsonEncode({
            'id': 'chat',
            'model': 'actual-model',
            'choices': [
              {'index': 0, 'delta': {}, 'finish_reason': 'stop'},
            ],
            'usage': {'prompt_tokens': 2, 'completion_tokens': 1, 'total_tokens': 3},
          })}\n\n',
        );
        if (request.uri.path == '/chat-a') request.response.write('data: [DONE]\n\n');
      } else {
        request.response.write(
          jsonEncode({
            'id': 'chat',
            'model': 'actual-model',
            'choices': [
              {
                'index': 0,
                'message': {'role': 'assistant', 'content': 'hello'},
                'finish_reason': 'stop',
              },
            ],
            'usage': {'prompt_tokens': 2, 'completion_tokens': 1, 'total_tokens': 3},
            'future': {
              'nested': [null, true],
            },
          }),
        );
      }
      await request.response.close();
      return;
    }
    if (body['stream'] == true) {
      request.response.headers.contentType = ContentType('text', 'event-stream');
      final renamed = request.uri.path == '/responses-b';
      request.response.write(
        'data: ${jsonEncode({'type': renamed ? 'vendor.text' : 'response.output_text.delta', 'output_index': 0, 'content_index': 0, 'delta': 'hello'})}\n\n',
      );
      request.response.write(
        'data: ${jsonEncode({
          'type': 'vendor.future',
          'unknown': [1],
        })}\n\n',
      );
      request.response.write(
        'data: ${jsonEncode({'type': renamed ? 'vendor.done' : 'response.completed', 'response': responseBody()})}\n\n',
      );
    } else {
      request.response.headers.contentType = ContentType.json;
      request.response.write(jsonEncode(responseBody()));
    }
    await request.response.close();
  });
  try {
    for (final alternate in [false, true]) {
      final path = alternate ? '/responses-b' : '/responses-a';
      final codec = ResponsesCodec(
        ResponsesDialect(
          providerId: alternate ? 'second' : 'first',
          route: (_) => base.resolve(path),
          authentication: () => {'authorization': 'explicit-fixture'},
          instructionRole: alternate ? 'developer' : null,
          eventAliases: alternate
              ? {'vendor.text': 'response.output_text.delta', 'vendor.done': 'response.completed'}
              : {},
        ),
      );
      final model = CompatibleResponsesModel(
        modelId: 'unknown-model',
        client: client,
        codec: codec,
      );
      final request = GenerationRequest(
        messages: [UserMessage.text('question')],
        instructions: 'instruction',
      );
      final before = records.length;
      final raw = success(
        await runtime.run(
          model.rawGenerate(
            request,
            options: const ResponsesOptions(extraBody: Setting.set({'neutral': true})),
          ),
        ),
      );
      final normalized = result(
        codec.normalize(raw.value, raw.raw, metadata: raw.metadata),
      );
      if (records.length != before + 1 || normalized.text != 'hello')
        throw StateError('native normalization repeated inference');
      if ((raw.raw.data as Map)['future'] == null)
        throw StateError('lost unknown native JSON');
      final body = records.last.body;
      if (body['store'] != false ||
          body['neutral'] != true ||
          body['max_output_tokens'] != 4096 ||
          records.last.auth != 'explicit-fixture')
        throw StateError('Responses wire policy');
      if (alternate ? body.containsKey('instructions') : body['instructions'] != 'instruction')
        throw StateError('instruction dialect');
      final common = model as LanguageModel;
      final unary = success(await runtime.run(common.generate(request)));
      final events = success(await runtime.run(common.stream(request).runCollect()));
      final streamed = events.whereType<GenerationFinished>().single.result;
      if (streamed.text != unary.text ||
          streamed.usage?.totalTokens != unary.usage?.totalTokens)
        throw StateError('Responses stream differs');
      if (streamed.native.unknownEvents.single['event'] != 'vendor.future')
        throw StateError('unknown stream event missing');
      final nativeRequest = result(codec.encode(request, 'unknown-model'));
      success(await runtime.run(model.create(nativeRequest)));
    }
    if (records.length != 8) throw StateError('unexpected Responses attempts');
    for (final alternate in [false, true]) {
      final dialect = ChatDialect(
        providerId: alternate ? 'second' : 'first',
        api: 'chat',
        endpoint: base.resolve(alternate ? '/chat-b' : '/chat-a'),
        headers: {'authorization': 'explicit-chat'},
        instructionRole: alternate ? 'developer' : 'system',
        maxTokensField: alternate ? 'max_completion_tokens' : 'max_tokens',
        terminalPolicy: alternate ? ChatTerminalPolicy.finishThenEof : ChatTerminalPolicy.sentinel,
      );
      final model = ChatLanguageModel(
        client: client,
        dialect: dialect,
        modelId: 'unknown-chat-model',
      );
      final request = GenerationRequest(
        messages: [UserMessage.text('question')],
        instructions: 'instruction',
      );
      final before = records.length;
      final raw = success(
        await runtime.run(
          model.rawGenerate(request, options: const ChatOptions(seed: Setting.set(7))),
        ),
      );
      final normalized = result(model.codec.normalize(raw));
      if (records.length != before + 1 || normalized.text != 'hello')
        throw StateError('Chat normalization repeated inference');
      if ((raw.raw.data as Map)['future'] == null) throw StateError('Chat unknown JSON');
      final body = records.last.body;
      if (body['n'] != 1 || body['seed'] != 7 || body[dialect.maxTokensField] != 4096)
        throw StateError('Chat wire options');
      if ((body['messages'] as List).first['role'] != dialect.instructionRole ||
          records.last.auth != 'explicit-chat')
        throw StateError('Chat configured dialect');
      final common = model as LanguageModel;
      final unary = success(await runtime.run(common.generate(request)));
      final events = success(await runtime.run(common.stream(request).runCollect()));
      final streamed = events.whereType<GenerationFinished>().single.result;
      if (streamed.text != unary.text || streamed.usage?.totalTokens != unary.usage?.totalTokens)
        throw StateError('Chat stream differs');
      final native = NativeChatRequest(
        model: 'unknown-chat-model',
        messages: [
          {'role': 'user', 'content': 'question'},
        ],
      );
      success(await runtime.run(model.native(native)));
    }
    if (records.length != 16) throw StateError('unexpected total protocol attempts');
  } finally {
    await client.close();
    await runtime.close();
    await server.close(force: true);
  }
}

T success<T>(Exit<T, AiError> exit) => switch (exit) {
  Succeeded(:final value) => value,
  Failed(:final cause) => throw StateError(
    'Provider failed: ${cause.expectedErrors.map((e) => e.message)}',
  ),
};
T result<T>(Result<T, AiError> result) => switch (result) {
  Success(:final value) => value,
  Failure(:final error) => throw StateError(error.message),
};
